name: Dejection: An Ode
source:
"Dejection: An Ode" is a historical, one-sided shoujo ai romance, set in late 1790s England.

"Dejection" deals with two young, female poets, Samantha and Lillian, as they struggle with their not-so-successful careers, writer’s block, depression, and their own friendship, which is slowly starting to fall apart.

Both characters are based on real English poets who were alive in the 1790s, and the VN is fairly accurate in following the lives of these two poets - though neither of them were cute girls in reality.

[Edited from [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/102454108386/dejection-an-ode-download]official site[/url]]
translation:
《沮丧：一首颂歌》是一部历史性的、片面的少女爱情爱情故事，背景设定在1790年代末的英国。

《沮丧》讲述了两位年轻的女诗人萨曼莎和莉莲的故事，她们与不那么成功的职业生涯、作家的障碍、抑郁以及她们自己的友谊作斗争，友谊正在慢慢开始破裂。

这两个角色都是根据活在1790年代的真实英国诗人改编的，而《越南新闻》相当准确地追踪了这两位诗人的生活——尽管他们在现实中都不是可爱的女孩。
